run_googletest_output_test: run the googletest output test to verify Google Test text output matches the golden file
generate_googletest_golden_file: generate the golden output file by running googletest-output-test.py with the --gengolden flag
normalize_test_output: normalize Google Test program output by removing file locations, stack traces, and time info
remove_locations_from_output: remove file location info from Google Test output replacing paths with normalized FILE_NAME format
remove_stack_traces: remove all stack trace details from Google Test program output using regex substitution
